settings.heading: About Subhan Fitness
settings.intro: Pakistan's home for premium fitness, gym and sports equipment — helping people train smarter and live stronger.

settings.heading: Built by people who love training
settings.text:
Subhan Fitness started with a simple goal: make quality fitness equipment accessible across Pakistan. From home-gym essentials to commercial-grade machines, we hand-pick every product for durability, performance and value.

Whether you're setting up your first home gym or upgrading a studio, our team is here to help you choose the right gear for your goals and your space.

settings.title: Quality First
settings.text: Durable, tested equipment from trusted brands — built to last.

settings.title: Nationwide Delivery
settings.text: Fast, careful delivery across Pakistan with cash on delivery available.

settings.title: Real Support
settings.text: Friendly, expert help before and after your purchase.

settings.heading: Train Hard. Live Strong.
settings.text: We believe fitness should be within everyone's reach. Our mission is to equip every athlete — beginner to pro — with reliable gear and honest advice, so nothing stands between you and your goals.

settings.heading: Join the Subhan Fitness community
settings.text: Get early access to new arrivals, training tips, and exclusive offers.
